Convert a raw dendrometer table to 'treenetproc' L0 format

Source: R/ingest.R
dm_build_l0.Rd

Ingests a raw logger table of almost any shape – long or wide, text or Excel origin – and returns the strict L0 long format used by 'treenetproc' and the rest of the dendromatic pipeline: series (character), ts (POSIXct) and value (micrometres). Handles timestamp parsing (including Excel serial dates), unit conversion (mm, cm, voltage- or resistance-based sensors to micrometres), species lookup, tree-number extraction and deduplication. raw_to_L0() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

raw_to_L0(
  df_raw,
  ts_col,
  value_col,
  tree_num_col = NULL,
  site,
  long_or_wide = c("long", "wide"),
  tz_in,
  tz_out = "UTC",
  measurement_unit = c("um", "mm", "cm", "voltage", "resistance"),
  species_col = NULL,
  metadata = NULL,
  meta_id_col = NULL,
  meta_species_col = NULL,
  species_abv = NULL,
  tree_num_pad = 3,
  tree_num_regex = "\\d+$",
  excel_epoch = c("windows", "mac"),
  date_format = NULL,
  supply_col = NULL,
  supply_voltage = NULL,
  scale_um = 11000,
  value_in_mv = FALSE,
  ohm_span = NULL,
  um_span = NULL,
  ohm_zero = 0,
  resist_invert = FALSE,
  treatment_col = NULL
)

dm_build_l0(
  df_raw,
  ts_col,
  value_col,
  tree_num_col = NULL,
  site,
  long_or_wide = c("long", "wide"),
  tz_in,
  tz_out = "UTC",
  measurement_unit = c("um", "mm", "cm", "voltage", "resistance"),
  species_col = NULL,
  metadata = NULL,
  meta_id_col = NULL,
  meta_species_col = NULL,
  species_abv = NULL,
  tree_num_pad = 3,
  tree_num_regex = "\\d+$",
  excel_epoch = c("windows", "mac"),
  date_format = NULL,
  supply_col = NULL,
  supply_voltage = NULL,
  scale_um = 11000,
  value_in_mv = FALSE,
  ohm_span = NULL,
  um_span = NULL,
  ohm_zero = 0,
  resist_invert = FALSE,
  treatment_col = NULL
)

Arguments

df_raw

Raw data.frame as read from the logger export.

ts_col

Name of the timestamp column in df_raw.

value_col

Name of the measurement column (long layout).

tree_num_col

Optional column holding the tree number; NULL to extract it from series names via tree_num_regex.

site

Site tag prepended to series identifiers (e.g. "HOL").

long_or_wide

"long" or "wide" input layout.

tz_in

Timezone of the input timestamps.

tz_out

Timezone of the output ts column.

measurement_unit

Input unit: "um", "mm" or "cm"; sensors reporting voltage or resistance are handled via the supply_*/ohm_* arguments.

species_col

Optional column with species codes or names.

metadata

Optional metadata data.frame joined by meta_id_col.

meta_id_col, meta_species_col

Column names in metadata holding the tree identifier and the species.

species_abv

Fallback species abbreviation when none can be derived.

tree_num_pad

Zero-padding width for tree numbers in series names.

tree_num_regex

Regex used to extract the tree number from raw ids.

excel_epoch

"windows" or "mac" Excel date origin.

date_format

Explicit timestamp format; NULL = auto-detect.

supply_col, supply_voltage, scale_um, value_in_mv

Conversion settings for voltage-based sensors.

ohm_span, um_span, ohm_zero, resist_invert

Conversion settings for resistance-based sensors.

treatment_col

Optional treatment column carried through to the output.

Value

A data.frame in L0 long format with columns series (character), ts (POSIXct in tz_out) and value (micrometres), deduplicated on (series, ts), plus any carried metadata columns.
